definitions.existing: Source-verified optional generated challenge stream. Separately labelled competitive match series remain inappropriate for continuous endless and are counted separately.
definitions.suitable: A bounded extension uses existing renewable/live mechanics without changing the defining contest; implementation and late-run balancing still required.
definitions.conditional: Plausible only with validated content generation/renewal, extra run-level resource rules or an explicitly separate variant.
definitions.inappropriate: Continuous endless play defeats the defining finite contest/story; separately labelled completed-match/scenario series may still be useful.
definitions.continuousChallengeChain: Different certified finite tasks share cumulative score/progression and one run-level failure reserve; individual tasks can finish without ending the run.
definitions.matchSeries: Complete competitive matches retain winners/draws and reset their board/hand between games; this is not continuous endless gameplay.

sourceEvidence.excerpt: finish(s,s.cells.some(v=>v<0)?'Assign every square as white or shaded.':quietError(s))

function quietError(s,cells=s.cells){const dark=range(cells.length).filter(i=>cells[i]===1),white=range(cells.length).filter(i=>cells[i]!==1);if(dark.some(i=>adj(i,s.n).some(j=>dark.includes(j))))return'Shaded cells cannot share an edge.';if(!connected(white,s.n))return'All white cells must stay connected.';for(let k=0;k<s.count;k++)if(dark.filter(i=>s.regions[i]===k).length!==s.quotas[k])return`Room ${String.fromCharCode(65+k)} needs ${s.quotas[k]} shaded cells.`;for(const horizontal of [true,false])for(let line=0;line<s.n;line++){let rooms=[];for(let k=0;k<s.n;k++){const i=horizontal?line*s.n+k:k*s.n+line;if(dark.includes(i)){rooms=[];continue}const region=s.regions[i];if(rooms.at(-1)!==region)rooms.push(region);if(rooms.length>2)return`An uninterrupted white ${horizontal?'row':'column'} crosses more than two rooms.`}}return null}

export function trial(s,ok,n){if(ok)win(s,n);else{ s.trials=(s.trials||0)+1;s.note=n+' '+(3-s.trials)+' inspections remain.';if(s.trials>=3)lose(s,n+' Three unsuccessful inspections ended this attempt.');}}

$('end-run').onclick=()=>{if(mode!=='endless'||!active||state.outcome!=='playing')return;cancelAnimationFrame(frame);engine.pause?.(state);endedByPlayer=true;state.note=`You banked ${Math.round(score())} points across ${stage} completed challenges. Play again for a fresh run.`;render()};
